cta_sentence: If you want to skip the expensive trial-and-error and get the exact wick, wax and fragrance pairings that just work, I put them all in my e-book, The $3 Luxury Candle:
body: I bought the cheapest wicks I could find and the most expensive wicks I could find and burned them side by side in identical candles to settle this once and for all. Two dollars versus twenty. In this video I show you exactly what your money does and doesn't buy with candle wicks, why consistency matters more than price, and the smarter third option I actually use that gives you premium results for almost bargain prices.
more: Candice has been making small-batch soy candles for over a decade. Every week I run real, honest tests like this one — no fluff, no sponsorships dressed up as advice, just what actually works. Subscribe and tell me in the comments: team cheap or team premium?
